recognize_zh: 這是臨床照片：兩隻大腳趾的甲溝（nail fold）邊緣可見紅色、濕潤結痂的肉芽樣組織與輕度紅腫，左側大腳趾外側甲溝最明顯，符合 ibrutinib 相關的甲周肉芽腫（periungual granuloma）或甲溝炎表現。
features: Clinical photograph of both great toes
Left great toe: linear red, moist, crusted granulation-like tissue along the lateral nail fold with mild surrounding erythema
Right great toe: smaller erythematous, crusted lesion at the medial nail fold
Nail plates intact without discoloration, onycholysis or subungual hemorrhage
No purulent discharge, vesicles or ulceration of the digit pulp visible
describe_en: Clinical photograph shows both great toes with erythematous, moist and crusted granulation-like tissue along the lateral nail fold of the left great toe and a smaller similar lesion at the medial nail fold of the right great toe. There is mild periungual erythema without obvious purulence, and the nail plates appear otherwise intact. This is a clinical rather than microscopic image, so histologic confirmation is not available here. In a patient on ibrutinib, findings are consistent with drug-associated periungual pyogenic granuloma-like lesions/paronychia.

ddx.vs: Ingrown nails are usually unilateral with a lateral nail spicule embedding in the fold and a mechanical history, whereas bilateral lesions on a kinase inhibitor favor drug toxicity.
Infectious paronychia shows purulence, fluctuance or cuticle loss with positive cultures, rather than dry crusted granulation tissue.

ddx.dx: Retinoid or EGFR inhibitor-induced periungual pyogenic granuloma
ddx.vs: These are clinically identical and are distinguished only by drug exposure history.

ddx.dx: Subungual/periungual squamous cell carcinoma or amelanotic melanoma
ddx.vs: Malignancy is usually solitary, persistent and destructive of the nail, and would require biopsy if lesions do not resolve after drug-related management.
